concept.title: Referral required
concept.shortdesc: Services that can only be used after a referral from the council, a health professional, another professional or an organisation.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Access arranged through referral from, or funding by, the local council or local authority, sometimes together with the NHS.
: Services that need a referral from a GP, doctor, nurse or other healthcare professional.
: Referral by a professional of any kind, such as a social worker or staff member, sometimes with self-referral also accepted.
: General statements that a referral is needed, or that referrals come from agencies, charities or other organisations, without naming a single kind of referrer.
